options.name: absolute_path
options.description: The absolute path of the folder to create. The absolute path should include the datacenter and the folder type. The leading slash is not required. For example the absolute path could be /DC-01/vm/my/folder or DC-01/vm/my/folder One of O(relative_path) or O(absolute_path) must be specified.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The name of the datacenter where the folder should be created. Only used if the O(relative_path) option is used.

options.name: folder_type
options.description: The type of folder that should be created. The folder type controls what resources can be held in the folder, as well as the path where the folder is created. For example, a folder at path /DC-01/vm/my/folder has folder type 'vm'. Only used if the O(relative_path) option is used.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: relative_path
options.description: The relative path of the folder to create. The relative path should include neither the datacenter nor the folder type. For example the relative path for the folder /DC-01/vm/my/folder is my/folder One of O(relative_path) or O(absolute_path) must be specified.

options.name: remove_vm_data
options.description: Only used if state is V(absent) If true, any VMs in the folder tree will be completely removed. This includes any disks or data associated with the VM. If false, any VMs in the folder tree are deregistered. This means they are removed from the vSphere inventory but their data is not deleted.

options.name: state
options.description: Create V(present) or remove V(absent) a vSphere folder. When state is V(present), all folders in the specified path will be created if they are missing. When state is V(absent), all content inside the folder will be deleted. See O(remove_vm_data)

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
